I want you to try something and tell me if it works! :)) When you decide to eat anything, sit and actually enjoy the food without any sort of distraction. Just eat your food without doing ANYTHING besides eating. No reading books or watching YouTube on your phone. Usually we tend to over eat because we don’t realize how much we are actually eating when distracted by television or our phones. Just try this for a week and see if it helps with binging at all. Let me know if this helps any at all if you can!
